'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 bombing of Odesa]]
****Two [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Kalibr]] [[cruise missile]]s hit [[Odesa]]'s [[Port of Odesa|port]] less than a day after a deal to export grain from Ukraine was signed between Russia and Ukraine. Initial reports indicate no related infrastructure damage. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-kyiv-global-trade-c1a004db6eef64d2aea48990a3080017 (AP)]
***A Russian cruise missile attack destroys a [[railway station]] in [[Kirovohrad Oblast]], killing three people and injuring several others. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20220723-live-washington-announces-270-million-in-military-aid-to-ukraine (France 24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Ukraine]]
**[[Fitch Ratings]] downgrades the Ukrainian debt outlook to "C", one grade above default, due to requests from Ukrainian authorities to postpone payments on bonds. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-07-22/ukraine-lowered-to-c-by-fitch-as-default-like-process-begins (Bloomberg)]
*[[Hong Kong]]-based airline [[Greater Bay Airlines]] completes its [[Maiden flight|maiden flight]] from [[Hong Kong International Airport|Hong Kong]] to [[Suvarnabhumi Airport|Bangkok]]. The airline has been granted licenses to operate 104 routes across the [[Greater China]] and [[Asia Pacific]] regions. [https://www.thestandard.com.hk/breaking-news/section/4/192640/Long-awaited-Greater-Bay-Airlines'-first-flight-takes-to-the-skies (''The Standard'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2022]]
**[[2022 European heat waves]]
***[[2022 European and Mediterranean wildfires]]
****In [[Greece]], nine people are rescued after [[wildfire]]s burn on the [[list of islands of Greece|island]] of [[Lesbos]] and threaten the resort town of [[Vatera]] amid a [[heat wave]] in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/greek-authorities-evacuate-coastal-properties-lesbos-wildfire-spreads-2022-07-23/ (Reuters)] [https://nypost.com/2022/07/23/9-people-rescued-as-wildfires-reach-greek-tourist-resort/amp/ (''The New York Post'')]
**[[2022 California wildfires]]
***The [[Oak Fire (2022)|Oak Fire]] in [[Mariposa County, California|Mariposa County]], [[California]], [[United States|U.S.]], grows to over 6,555 acres near the [[Yosemite National Park]], with 10 homes destroyed. [https://www.axios.com/2022/07/23/california-oak-fire-yosemite-grows (''Axios'')]
*[[Flash flood]]s kill at least 21 people after the Roudbal River overflowed in [[Estahban]], [[Fars Province]], [[Iran]]. Fifty-five others are rescued and six others remain missing. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-middle-east-iran-droughts-5c85c70b56071d51ef0e43ab4d73167f (AP)]
*Ten people are killed and seven are injured after a mountainside slope collapses in [[Jingtai County]], [[Gansu]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-3e8d1bfaae037cc4860742dfe95bd5fa (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in Japan]]
****[[Japan]] begins administering fourth doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] for medical staff and care workers for the elderly. [https://japantoday.com/category/national/tokyo-begins-4th-vaccinations-of-medical-workers-amid-7th-wave (''Japan Today'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the Republic of Ireland]]
****The [[Minister for Health (Ireland)|Irish Ministry of Health]] announces changes to [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]]'s [[vaccination]] program including a second booster dose for people between the ages of 50 and 64 years and a first dose of an [[mRNA vaccine]] for children between the ages of 5 and 11 years who are immunocompromised. [https://www.thejournal.ie/changes-to-covid-19-vaccination-programme-health-minister-stephen-donnelly-5824392-Jul2022/?amp=1 (''TheJournal.ie'')] [https://www.gov.ie/en/press-release/c4407-minister-for-health-announces-updates-to-irelands-covid-19-vaccination-programme-23-july-2022/ (gov.ie)] 
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**The [[monkeypox]] outbreak is declared a [[Public Health Emergency of International Concern]] by the [[World Health Organization]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/23/monkeypox-who-declares-public-health-emergency-of-international-concern (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*An [[Aerolíneas Argentinas]] flight makes an [[emergency landing]] in [[Comodoro Rivadavia]], [[Chubut Province]], after a bomb threat. The flight with 169 passengers and six crew members was flying from [[Buenos Aires]] to [[Ushuaia]], [[Tierra del Fuego Province, Argentina|Tierra del Fuego Province]]. [https://www.infobae.com/sociedad/2022/07/23/amenaza-de-bomba-en-un-vuelo-de-aerolineas-argentinas-aterrizo-en-comodoro-rivadavia/ (Infobae)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Vanuatuan presidential election]]
**[[Nikenike Vurobaravu]] is elected [[President of Vanuatu]] by the country's Electoral College in the eighth round of voting and will succeed outgoing President [[Tallis Obed Moses]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/471500/after-eight-rounds-of-voting-vanuatu-elects-new-president (RNZ)]
*[[Prime Minister of Thailand]] [[Prayut Chan-o-cha]] survives a [[no-confidence vote]] with 256 confidence votes, 206 votes against and nine abstentions. [https://apnews.com/article/elections-thailand-general-bangkok-633ca9ff2bb39305e81f6fc7166b8cf9 (AP)]
